consequence.statement: Pod restart events no longer have the Pod as regardingObject, so field-selectors listing events by the Pod's regardingObject will no longer match them; the selector must specify the Kafka resource instead.
consequence.remediation: Update event field-selectors to use the Kafka resource as regardingObject.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject; field-selectors on regardingObject must now target the Kafka resource.
